title: VA Home Loan Guaranty Overpayment Reserve on Restoration by Substitution
content:
A seller whose VA Home Loan Guaranty entitlement is restored by substitution has an overpayment reserve taken from it where the seller owes a Disability Compensation Overpayment, according to that overpayment's state and current balance in the seller's Benefit Debts and Overpayment Recovery records.

## The overpayment reserve

| Disability Compensation Overpayment in active collection | Disability Compensation Overpayment under a repayment plan | Overpayment reserve |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | No | The balance of the overpayment in active collection |
| No | Yes | The plan reserve percentage, 50 percent, of the balance of the overpayment under the plan |
| Yes | Yes | Nothing |
| No | No | Nothing |

## Cases (hypothetical)

- An overpayment of 4,800.00 dollars in active collection, none under a plan: the reserve is 4,800.00 dollars.
- An overpayment with a balance of 4,800.00 dollars under a repayment plan, none in active collection: the reserve is 4,800.00 multiplied by 50 and divided by one hundred, or 2,400.00 dollars.
- No Disability Compensation Overpayment owed: nothing is reserved.

Only a debt of the Disability Compensation Overpayment type is read for this reserve.
